ADM
Description
iRules commands and events for working with the ADM namespace.
Commands
ADM::health
- Return health value as
integer. Lower values are good health
ADM::is_ip_slowdown
- Returns TRUE
if source IP exists in greylist table
ADM::is_mitigated
- Returns TRUE if
certain HTTP request was mitigated by ADM
